widget_mechanic: When a plus-chip filter is set (e.g. '3+ bedrooms'), results include all N ≥ 3. To require EXACTLY N, agent must locate and enable the 'use exact match' toggle — usually below the plus-chip row or inside an advanced filters panel.

source_inspiration.instruction: Can you help me find a 3 bedroom house with at least 2 bathrooms in Oviedo, Florida, located near top-rated schools?
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [6.4] Fine-grained grounding error: The coordinate marker is on the left sidebar (near the Search icon) rather than within the main address search input where the typing occurred.
